message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "cross_verify_mediastinal_shift_with_multi_view_xray", "description": "When post-operative chest radiographs show ambiguous mediastinal or cardiac displacement, use multiple views to confirm spatial relationships.", "applicable_conditions": "Post-operative chest imaging cases where initial single-view interpretation of mediastinal shift, cardiac position, or hemithorax opacity is inconclusive or suggests complex pathology (e.g., herniation vs. effusion).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If a post-operative chest X-ray shows ambiguous mediastinal or cardiac displacement: (1) call `chest_xray_report_generator` on all available views (e.g., PA and Lateral); (2) compare the reported spatial relationship of the heart and mediastinum across views; (3) confirm complex pathologies like cardiac herniation only if displacement into the affected hemithorax is consistent across views, distinguishing it from simple effusion or pneumothorax."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
